prompt: What can workers establish before taking out a shutter?
promptZh: 工作人員在取出窗板之前可以確認什麼？

options.text: Whether the mounting holes line up.
options.whyZh: 紙卡的孔位是運送用夾具的位置，安裝位置由技術人員另查。

options.text: Whether the shipping clips can be reused.
options.zh: 運送用的夾具能不能再用。
options.whyZh: 目前只需要留著夾具，不必判斷能不能重複使用。

options.text: Whether the panel can already be installed.
options.whyZh: 外形吻合不代表安裝位置已核對，所以還不能據此判定。

options.text: Whether the outline covers the opening.
options.whyZh: 不用抬出窗板；拿紙卡樣板比對窗框即可先核對外形。

explanationZh: 不用抬出窗板；拿紙卡樣板比對窗框即可先核對外形。
evidence: Hold the edge of the template against the frame to see whether it covers the opening. / That only checks the outline.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Hold the edge of the template against the frame to see whether it covers the opening.
